<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_3DModel" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/3d-model-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Instruction" name="Instruction to create a 3D model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="3D model STL"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instruction" name="Instruction" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Start_Artist" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" name="3D model STL" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveChanges" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Approval" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Craving a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct artist to create a project" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches to artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive 3D model STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApproval" name="Approve the result" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorAtHome" name="Is the color at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much color is left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Is the amount under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put color on shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderColor" name="Order color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorReadyMerge" name="Continue with plastic"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and G-code"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatPrinter" name="Turn on printer and heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received" attachedToRef="Task_HeatPrinter" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGCode" name="Generate G-code from STL"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer and G-code ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printing" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendApproval">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" sourceRef="Task_SendApproval" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAtHome = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorAtHome" targetRef="Task_OrderColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAtHome = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remainingGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReadyMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remainingGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Task_OrderColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorReadyMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_HeatPrinter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGCode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" sourceRef="Task_HeatPrinter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGCode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="End_Printing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Artist" name="Instruction received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Instruction" messageRef="Message_Instruction"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateModel" name="Create 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSTL" name="Send 3D model STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ArtistWait" name="Wait for approval or requested changes" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveChanges" name="Receive requested changes" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseModel" name="Revise 3D model as requested"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApproval" name="Receive approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Artist" name="Model approved"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_1" sourceRef="Start_Artist" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_3" sourceRef="Task_CreateModel" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_4" sourceRef="Task_SendSTL" targetRef="Gateway_ArtistWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ArtistWait" targetRef="Task_ReceiveChanges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_6" sourceRef="Gateway_ArtistWait" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveChanges" targetRef="Task_ReviseModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_8" sourceRef="Task_ReviseModel" targetRef="Task_SendSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_9" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" targetRef="End_Artist"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
